name: cpu-pilot-holdout-v1
color_assignment: 50 white, 50 black for each agent per pair
interval: 95% bootstrap over color-swapped pairs; 10000 resamples, RNG seed 90210
success_criterion: Both the trained-vs-initial win-rate interval lower bound exceeds 0.5 and the trained-minus-initial random win-rate interval lower bound exceeds zero.
limitations: One training seed and modified 29-ply rules. Evaluation is held out from promotion/random-monitor seeds. No parameter or checkpoint selection based on these holdout results.
